protocol.probes: 24 hand-written policy cases from data/probes.jsonl, including multi-turn clarifications; exchange tool stubbed
protocol.test_split: official BANKING77 test split, scored once through the full graph; thresholds and copy frozen from earlier milestones
protocol.tool_stub: 1 base = 0.9000 quote as of 2026-01-02; TRY rejected like the live API
protocol.latency: in-process graph invocation, single thread, exchange stubbed; excludes network time (measured separately in M5)

details.why: Unambiguous FAQ-covered intent: the baseline answer path.

turns.text: I would like to change my pin number please

details.why: A failure the curated corpus covers; no human needed at first contact.

turns.text: my top up failed but the money left my bank account

details.why: 'what is' is a rate cue, but with no currency pair it must not reach the tool.

turns.text: what is my top up limit?

details.why: A pair plus a conversion verb in an app how-to question: the 'app' cue must suppress the quote and keep the FAQ answer.

turns.text: I want to exchange USD to EUR in the app

details.why: Capability question: 'exchange' with no amount is not a request for a quote.

turns.text: I need to exchange USD for GBP

details.why: No usable signal: ask, never assert.

turns.text: help

details.why: A rate question without a pair is a clarification, not a default pair.

turns.text: what is the exchange rate?

details.why: The classifier puts this at fiat_currency_support 0.067; the pair and amount are the request.

turns.text: how much is 500 dollars in euros?

details.why: The classifier is confidently wrong here (fiat_currency_support 0.911); the explicit pair outranks it.

turns.text: convert 250 EUR to CHF

details.why: Aliases resolve to ISO codes and direction follows the amount, not word order.

turns.text: how many quid is 200 bucks

details.why: A product verb with an explicit amount is a quote request, not a capability question.

turns.text: exchange 500 USD to EUR

details.why: 'swap' is not in BANKING77's vocabulary at all, so only the structural rule can serve it.

turns.text: swap 200 EUR for GBP

details.why: A pair with no amount is answered per unit; the response states the rate rather than inventing an amount.

turns.text: what is the rate for GBP to JPY

details.why: The 'fee' cue stops the tool: a fee question must not be answered with a rate. Clarifying is acceptable; quoting is not.

turns.text: what fee applies if I convert 500 USD to EUR?

details.why: The 'how can i' cue stops the tool: an app how-to question is not a quote request.

turns.text: how can I convert 500 USD to EUR?

details.why: Frankfurter does not publish TRY. The failure must be an answer plus a recorded error, not an exception.

turns.text: convert 500 USD to TRY

details.why: The sharpest suppression case: pair, amount, and a rate cue, but it is a dispute and must never be answered with a live quote.

turns.text: I was charged the wrong rate on a 500 USD to EUR payment

details.why: Same family without a pair; still a dispute.

turns.text: I was charged the wrong exchange rate on my card payment

details.why: Fraud and loss reports go to a person regardless of confidence.

turns.text: I lost my card, please block it before someone uses it

details.why: Unauthorised use is protected even at 0.976 confidence.

turns.text: someone used my card without permission

details.why: Confident, but outside the 42 intent corpus: hand off instead of improvising.

turns.text: can I use apple pay

details.why: The second turn must not be re-classified: the pending intent turns a bare pair into a quote.

turns.text: what is the exchange rate?
500 USD to EUR

details.why: A clarification must not trap the user: a real new question is classified normally.

turns.text: what is the exchange rate?
my card was declined at the shop

details.why: Half an answer keeps the intent pending and asks again without inventing the other side of the pair.

turns.text: I need a rate
euros

test_split.precision_definition: share of auto-answered messages whose predicted intent matches the gold label; an exchange quote counts as correct only when the gold intent is exchange_rate

classifier_policy.note: M2 definition, recomputed here: confident and wide-margin and not a never-auto intent, whether or not curated copy exists. M2 reported 2220/3080 at 0.9622; the workflow answers fewer because uncovered intents escalate instead of improvising.

never_auto.safety_note: The first count must be zero by construction; the second is the residual risk from misclassifying a protected intent as a safe one.

samples.text: I can't transfer money from my account.
Is there a fee for exchanging cash?

false_auto_answers.text: When will I get my card?
false_auto_answers.answer: Delivery timing depends on your country and the card type; the app shows the current estimate for your order.

false_auto_answers.text: How long does a card delivery take?
false_auto_answers.answer: Delivery timing depends on your country and the card type; the app shows the current estimate for your order.

false_auto_answers.text: Do you support any currency?
false_auto_answers.answer: Tell me the merchant country and currency and I can say whether it is a supported combination, or pass it to an agent.

false_auto_answers.text: How do I change currencies to euros?
false_auto_answers.answer: Currency exchange in the app is under the balance or card screen; I cannot perform the exchange for you.

false_auto_answers.text: Am I able to exchange currencies?
false_auto_answers.answer: If the exchange option is not shown for your currency, it may not be supported for your account type.

false_auto_answers.text: I want to make a currency exchange to EU.
false_auto_answers.answer: If the exchange option is not shown for your currency, it may not be supported for your account type.

false_auto_answers.text: Can I exchange currencies?
false_auto_answers.answer: If the exchange option is not shown for your currency, it may not be supported for your account type.

false_auto_answers.text: I am waiting for my card to arrive.
false_auto_answers.answer: Card orders can be tracked in the app under Cards. If tracking shows the card as sent and it has not arrived, an agent can start a trace with the delivery provider.

false_auto_answers.text: How do I unblock my card using the app?
false_auto_answers.answer: A blocked PIN is usually unblocked with the PIN letter or through the app. If neither works, an agent has to reset it.

false_auto_answers.text: How do I reset my PIN, I can't seem to use my card?
false_auto_answers.answer: Check that the card is activated and not frozen in the app. If it still fails, note the time, amount and merchant so an agent can check the decline.

false_auto_answers.text: My card's frozen, what can I do?
false_auto_answers.answer: Check that the card is activated and not frozen in the app. If it still fails, note the time, amount and merchant so an agent can check the decline.

false_auto_answers.text: Will a transfer incur a fee?
false_auto_answers.answer: I cannot refund a transfer fee. An agent can explain which fee applied and why.

false_auto_answers.text: What are the fees for top-ups?
false_auto_answers.answer: I cannot waive or refund a fee. An agent can explain which fee applied to a specific top-up.

false_auto_answers.text: Topping up my card is not working because I believe the top up is pending
false_auto_answers.answer: Failed top-ups are usually a declined funding source or a limit. The app shows the status of the last attempt.

false_auto_answers.text: transaction failed?
false_auto_answers.answer: A failed transfer is normally returned to your balance. The app shows the failure reason and the return.

false_auto_answers.text: The receipient doesn't see my money transfer.
false_auto_answers.answer: Bank transfers usually update after the sending bank settles. If your bank shows it as sent, the app may need a moment or a trace.

false_auto_answers.text: I believe my money did not go through with my top up, was there a problem on your end?
false_auto_answers.answer: If the money left your bank but the balance did not change, an agent needs to trace it rather than retry.

false_auto_answers.text: On my last transaction it seem that my top-up was not successful.
false_auto_answers.answer: Failed top-ups are usually a declined funding source or a limit. The app shows the status of the last attempt.

false_auto_answers.text: The balance on my account wasn't updated after I made a depost.
false_auto_answers.answer: If it has been sent and your balance has not moved, an agent can check the incoming reference.

false_auto_answers.text: Do I need to verify my identity?
false_auto_answers.answer: Verification usually needs a document photo and a selfie in the app; I cannot verify an identity here.

false_auto_answers.text: It is impossible to verify my identity
false_auto_answers.answer: Identity checks are a regulatory requirement for holding an account and moving money; the app explains the specific requirement for your case.

false_auto_answers.text: I can't verify my identity.
false_auto_answers.answer: Verification usually needs a document photo and a selfie in the app; I cannot verify an identity here.

false_auto_answers.text: What do i need to verify my id?
false_auto_answers.answer: Verification usually needs a document photo and a selfie in the app; I cannot verify an identity here.

false_auto_answers.text: Why can't I verify my identity?
false_auto_answers.answer: Identity checks are a regulatory requirement for holding an account and moving money; the app explains the specific requirement for your case.

false_auto_answers.text: What do I need to do for a PIN?
false_auto_answers.answer: A blocked PIN is usually unblocked with the PIN letter or through the app. If neither works, an agent has to reset it.
